capabilities: Search retro and modern game databases and create notes with box art, details, and properties
Sort game notes into status folders and update links when status changes
Fetch game info for existing notes without overwriting your data
View a dashboard library grouped by status with a beaten log and yearly charts
Log completed games with date, rating, and hours played
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Retro search works offline after the first per-system download (cached, refreshed every 90 days); the RAWG key is stored in data.json and should not be committed or published.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track played games or pull game metadata and cover art into notes automatically.

relations.evidence: It borrows from how RetroArch identifies games
Game lists and details come from the libretro database, the same data RetroArch uses
switch the source to Modern games (RAWG) in the search window
Descriptions for systems where libretro has none are looked up on Wikipedia
All plain properties, so Dataview and Bases can use them too

summary: Media tracker for video games that searches retro and modern game databases to create notes with box art, and logs play status on a dashboard.
